subject: Distance Between Two Co-ordinates
construct: Calculate the distance between two coordinates in 2D, where all the values are integers but at least one is negative
question_en: Amy is trying to work out the distance between these two points: \( (2,-5) \) and \( (-7,1) \) She labels them like this: \( \begin{array}{cccc}x_{1} & y_{1} & x_{2} & y_{2} \\ (2, & -5) & (-7, & 1)\end{array} \) And then decides to use this formula: \( \sqrt{\left(x_{2}-x_{1}\right)^{2}+\left(y_{2}-y_{1}\right)^{2}} \) What does the first bracket equal?
misconception_name: When subtracting a negative number from a positive number, uses a method which assumes one of the negative signs can be ignored

EN.question: Amy is trying to work out the distance between these two points: \( (2,-5) \) and \( (-7,1) \) She labels them like this: \( \begin{array}{cccc}x_{1} & y_{1} & x_{2} & y_{2} \\ (2, & -5) & (-7, & 1)\end{array} \) And then decides to use this formula: \( \sqrt{\left(x_{2}-x_{1}\right)^{2}+\left(y_{2}-y_{1}\right)^{2}} \) What does the first bracket equal?

HI.question: एमी इन दो बिंदुओं के बीच की दूरी ज्ञात करने की कोशिश कर रही है: \( (2,-5) \) और \( (-7,1) \) वह उन्हें इस तरह लेबल करती है: \( \begin{array}{cccc}x_{1} & y_{1} & x_{2} & y_{2} \\ (2, & -5) & (-7, & 1)\end{array} \) और फिर इस सूत्र का उपयोग करने का फैसला करती है: \( \sqrt{\left(x_{2}-x_{1}\right)^{2}+\left(y_{2}-y_{1}\right)^{2}} \) पहला ब्रैकेट किसके बराबर है?

HI-EN.question: Amy in do points \( (2,-5) \) aur \( (-7,1) \) ke beech ki distance nikalne ki koshish kar rahi hai. subject: Simultaneous Equations
construct: Recognise whether you need to add or subtract linear equations in order to eliminate a variable
question_en:
Tom and Katie are discussing this pair of simultaneous equations: \( \begin{array}{l}3 x-2 y=15 \\ x+2 y=20\end{array} \) Tom says if you add the two equations together you will eliminate a variable

Katie says if you subtract the two equations together you will eliminate a variable

Who is correct?
misconception_name: Subtracts simultaneous equations when addition is required

EN.question:
Tom and Katie are discussing this pair of simultaneous equations: \( \begin{array}{l}3 x-2 y=15 \\ x+2 y=20\end{array} \) Tom says if you add the two equations together you will eliminate a variable

Katie says if you subtract the two equations together you will eliminate a variable

Who is correct?

HI.question:
टॉम और केटी एक साथ समीकरणों की इस जोड़ी पर चर्चा कर रहे हैंः \( \begin{array}{l}3 x-2 y=15 \\ x+2 y=20\end{array} \) टॉम का कहना है कि यदि आप दोनों समीकरणों को एक साथ जोड़ते हैं तो आप एक चर को समाप्त कर देंगे।

केटी का कहना है कि यदि आप दोनों समीकरणों को एक साथ घटाते हैं तो आप एक चर को समाप्त कर देंगे।

कौन सही है?

BN.question:
টম এবং কেটি যুগপৎ সমীকরণের এই জোড়া নিয়ে আলোচনা করছেনঃ \( \begin{array}{l}3 x-2 y=15 \\ x+2 y=20\end{array} \) টম বলেছেন যে আপনি যদি দুটি সমীকরণ একসাথে যোগ করেন তবে আপনি একটি পরিবর্তনশীলকে বাদ দেবেন।

কেটি বলেছেন যে আপনি যদি দুটি সমীকরণ একসঙ্গে বিয়োগ করেন তবে আপনি একটি পরিবর্তনশীলকে বাদ দেবেন।

কার কথা ঠিক?

subject: Plotting Quadratics from Tables of Values
construct: Substitute positive non-integer values into expressions involving powers or roots
question_en:
Jo and Paul are discussing quadratic equations.

Jo says there is no value of \( x \) that can make \( (1-x)^{2} \) negative.

Paul says there is no value of \( x \) that can make \( 1-x^{2} \) positive.
Who is correct?
misconception_name: Assumes a fact without considering enough examples

EN.question:
Jo and Paul are discussing quadratic equations.

Jo says there is no value of \( x \) that can make \( (1-x)^{2} \) negative.

Paul says there is no value of \( x \) that can make \( 1-x^{2} \) positive.

पॉल का कहना है कि \( x \) का कोई मान नहीं है जो \( 1-x^{2} \) को सकारात्मक बना सकता है।

subject: Expanding Triple Brackets and more
construct: Expand products of three binomials in the form (x + a)(x + b)(x + c)
question_en:
Ori is expanding these three brackets:
\(
(x+2)(x-4)(x-7)
\)

He finds it helpful to split the first bracket and view the problem as follows:
\(
x(x-4)(x-7)+2(x-4)(x-7)
\)

Ori is expanding these three brackets:
\(
(x+2)(x-4)(x-7)
\)

\(
x(x-4)(x-7)+2(x-4)(x-7)
\)

He expands the brackets further. Before he simplifies, what are the terms than contain an \( x^{2} \) ?

\)

\(
x(x-4)(x-7)+2(x-4)(x-7)
\)

वह कोष्ठकों का और विस्तार करता है। इससे पहले कि वह सरलीकरण करे, \( x^{2} \) के अलावा कौन से शब्द हैं?

\(

\)

\(
x(x-4)(x-7)+2(x-4)(x-7)
\)

তিনি বন্ধনীগুলিকে আরও প্রসারিত করেন। তিনি সরলীকরণ করার আগে, একটি \( x^{2} \) ছাড়া আর কোন শর্তাবলী রয়েছে?

\(

subject: Mental Addition and Subtraction
construct: Understand the non-commutativity of subtraction
question_en:
Miran says the following:

“It doesn't matter if you do \( 81-53 \) or \( 53-81 \), you get the same answer."

What do you think?
correct_answer_en: Miran is incorrect because subtraction is not commutative
student_answer_en: Miran is incorrect because subtraction is commutative
misconception_name: Does not understand the meaning of the word commutative

EN.question:
Miran says the following:

“It doesn't matter if you do \( 81-53 \) or \( 53-81 \), you get the same answer."

What do you think?
EN.student_answer: Miran is incorrect because subtraction is commutative
EN.correct_answer: Miran is incorrect because subtraction is not commutative

"इससे कोई फर्क नहीं पड़ता कि आप \( 81-53 \) या \( 53-81 \) करते हैं, आपको वही जवाब मिलता है।"

आपको क्या लगता है?
HI.student_answer: मिरान गलत है क्योंकि घटाव परिवर्तनीय है।
HI.correct_answer: मिरान गलत है क्योंकि घटाव परिवर्तनीय नहीं है।

"আপনি যদি \( 81-53 \) বা \( 53-81 \) করেন তবে কিছু যায় আসে না, আপনি একই উত্তর পাবেন।"

আপনি কি মনে করেন?
BN.correct_answer: মিরান ভুল কারণ বিয়োগ বিনিময়যোগ্য নয়।

subject: Mental Addition and Subtraction
construct: Given the solution to one problem, deduce the answer to a related problem using the same operation
question_en:
Tom and Katie are discussing related calculations
Tom says if you know that \( 3748+426=4174 \), then \( 3748+427 \) must equal \( \mathbf{4 1 7 5} \)

Katie says if you know that \( 3748-426=3322 \), then \( 3748 \) - \( 427 \) must equal \( \mathbf{3 3 2 3} \)
Who is correct?
misconception_name: Does not realise that subtracting a larger number will give a smaller answer

EN.question:
Tom and Katie are discussing related calculations
Tom says if you know that \( 3748+426=4174 \), then \( 3748+427 \) must equal \( \mathbf{4 1 7 5} \)

Katie says if you know that \( 3748-426=3322 \), then \( 3748 \) - \( 427 \) must equal \( \mathbf{3 3 2 3} \)
Who is correct?

HI.question:
टॉम और केटी संबंधित गणनाओं पर चर्चा कर रहे हैं।
टॉम कहता है कि अगर आप जानते हैं कि \( 3748+426=4174 \), तो \( 3748+427 \) को \( \mathbf{4 1 7 5} \) के बराबर होना चाहिए।

केटी का कहना है कि यदि आप जानते हैं कि \( 3748-426=3322 \), तो \( 3748 \)-\( 427 \) को \( \mathbf{3 3 2 3} \) के बराबर होना चाहिए।
कौन सही है?

BN.question:
টম এবং কেটি সম্পর্কিত গণনা নিয়ে আলোচনা করছে।
টম বলে যে আপনি যদি জানেন যে \( 3748+426=4174 \), তাহলে \( 3748+427 \) অবশ্যই \( \mathbf{4 1 7 5} \) এর সমান হবে।

কেটি বলেছেন যে আপনি যদি জানেন যে \( 3748-426=3322 \), তাহলে \( 3748 \)-\( 427 \) অবশ্যই \( \mathbf{3 3 2 3} \) এর সমান হতে হবে।
কার কথা ঠিক?

HI-EN.question: Tom aur Katie related calculations ke baare mein discuss kar rahe hain. Tom kehta hai agar tum jante ho ki \( 3748+426=4174 \), to \( 3748+427 \) must equal \( \mathbf{4 1 7 5} \). BN-EN.question: Tom bole jodi tumi jano je \( 3748+426=4174 \), tahole \( 3748+427 \) must equal \( \mathbf{4 1 7 5} \). Katie bole jodi tumi jano je \( 3748-426=3322 \), tahole \( 3748 \) - \( 427 \) must equal \( \mathbf{3 3 2 3} \). Ke thik?

কার কথা ঠিক?
